podcast.body: memoir : Ben Watt, from Everything But The Girl, wrote a memoir titled *Patient* detailing his personal experiences after being hospitalized in 1992 with Churg-Strauss syndrome. The book delves into his health struggles, including losing his voice and a significant portion of his intestine. "Ben was first hospitalized in 1992 and wrote a memoir about his experience as called patient."
